headline: Alphabet Shares Fall as Search Issues and Earnings Trigger AI Concerns
summary: Alphabet shares plummeted following quarterly results showing problems in its search business. The disappointment depressed Nasdaq futures and renewed AI-related jitters across tech markets.
why: Alphabet Inc. is the parent company of Google and one of the largest technology companies by market capitalization globally.

impacts.name: Alphabet Inc.
impacts.why: Slower core growth and increased capital expenditure plans sparked selling pressure from investors.

why_moved: Concerns over Alphabet's core search revenues and rising capital expenditure plans weighed on investor confidence in big tech earnings.
